course.title: Digital Logic Design
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Design a sequential circuit that continuously reads a serial stream of input bits and (17) [CO3] outputs a “1” whenever it detects the sequence “1011”. Derive the state equations using a T flip-flop and a D flip-flop. Explain all the steps of this design process with necessary diagrams and tables.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2024
